name: Jarvis
author: Gustavo von Atzingen
description: Local-first voice assistant for Omarchy: wake word, natural conversation, barge-in, Codex/Claude answers with machine access gated by per-action consent (sandboxed by default), live conversation window, dictation (speech-to-text into the active window). Bar widget with status, dictation controls and settings.

barWidget.description: Voice assistant status (on / paused / off / recording) with a hover panel in cards: voice guide, dictation (speech-to-text) start/stop, keybindings, on/off, pause, logs, settings.
